text:
The home mountain of the Greek Gods is Mount Olympus.

To understand the complex concepts in the provided text, consider this analogy: Imagine the Internet is like a massive, chaotic city where every building is a website and every room inside those buildings is a web page. If you are looking for a specific room, trying to walk through every building would take forever. A search engine acts like a highly efficient city map and directory system. It doesn't just show you the city; it tells you exactly which building (website) and which room (web page) contains the information you need, saving you from wandering aimlessly.
